item.title: Four shot dead on US-registered speedboat by border guards, Cuba says
item.description: Four people who entered Cuban waters on a US-registered speedboat have been shot dead by border guards, Cuba s government said. MORE..

item.title: Fire breaks out at Kerawalapitiya garbage dumping yard
item.description: A fire has broken out at the Kerawalapitiya garbage dumping yard near the highway entrance. MORE..

item.title: Customs officers continue trade union action over unresolved issues
item.description: The black armband protest launched by customs trade unions will continue today (26) as well, the Customs Trade Union Alliance said. MORE..

item.title: Dy Minister holds talks to expand foreign employment pathways for Sri Lankans in South Korea
item.description: Bilateral discussions have been held between Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Arun Hemachandra and the Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, Eui-hae Cecilia Chung at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Korea in Seoul. MORE..

item.title: Australian tourist drowns off Weligama coast
item.description: An Australian national drowned while swimming off the coast of Pelena in Weligama yesterday (25), police stated. MORE..

item.title: Hong Kong court overturns China critic Jimmy Lai s fraud conviction in rare legal victory
item.description: Pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai s fraud conviction and prison sentence were overturned by a Hong Kong court on Thursday, in a surprise legal decision that comes soon after Lai was jailed for 20 years on a separate national security charge. MORE..

item.title: Alarming surge in colon and rectal cancers among 30–50 age group in Sri Lanka- Health authorities
item.description: Health authorities have raised concern over a growing incidence of colon and rectal cancers among individuals aged 30 to 50 in Sri Lanka, reflecting a similar global trend. MORE..

item.title: Three teenage girls arrested over break-in at Kalutara stadium canteen
item.description: Three teenage girls have been arrested for allegedly breaking into the canteen of the Vernon U Fernando Stadium in Kalutara and stealing confectioneries and chocolates worth nearly Rs. 40,000, police said. MORE..

item.title: PM Modi becomes first world leader to cross 100 million Instagram followers
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday became the first world leader and politician to cross 100 million followers on Instagram, marking a new milestone in his global digital presence. MORE..

item.title: Indian Navy s sail training ship INS Tarangini to visit Trincomalee tomorrow
item.description: Indian Navy s Sail Training Ship INS Tarangini is scheduled to arrive in Trincomalee from tomorrow to March 02 and Colombo from March 06 to March 09. MORE..
